Jammerbugt is a Danish municipality referenced in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. It is one of the 98 Danish municipalities analyzed in the report to facilitate local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. 

The entity's significance in this corpus is strictly statistical: Jammerbugt's data regarding stroke (apopleksi) events among atrial fibrillation patients is included in the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic strokes via anticoagulation (AK) treatment [^src1]. Its specific performance metrics are listed in a municipal data table on page 95 [^src1]. Because the source material is a statistical registry report, no further narrative details, relationships, or timeline events are available for Jammerbugt.
